title: Voice on Fire
style:
Voice on Fire (Revised Strict A Cappella Prompt)
textSTRICT HIGH-ENERGY A CAPPELLA JAZZ ONLY — 100% PURE HUMAN VOICES, ZERO INSTRUMENTS WHATSOEVER. No piano, no bass, no drums, no guitar, no percussion, no backing track, no synthesized elements, no hidden music, no subtle accompaniment of any kind. Every single sound must come from human voices only. Powerful passionate lead jazz vocalist + tight vocal harmony group with explosive call-and-response energy creating ALL melody, harmony, rhythm and fiery swing exclusively through layered voices and rapid scatting. Hotter, sharper, wicked vocal jazz energy. No instruments allowed even faintly in the background. Lyrics exactly as follows:
lyrics:
[Intro Scat – Group igniting fast]
Ba-da-ba-dee ba-doo ba-da! 
Fire in the line, let it burn, let it fly! 
Ba-da-ba-dee ba-doo ba-da-da!

[Verse 1]
Room drops cold but the air starts to crack
No keys, no strings, no rhythm looking back
Just breath and intention and the spark in the chest
The moment it catches, there’s no second guess

No cushion to lean on, no cover to hide
The flame doesn’t ask — it just opens wide
Blue notes turning white when the heat gets high
This is what happens when the voice decides

[Pre-Chorus]
Strip it all down till there’s nothing but sound
That’s where the real fire gets found

[Chorus]
Voice on fire, wicked and bright
Burning through the silence in the dead of the night
No instruments holding, no safety to tame
This is the pure heat that carries the name

Swing it hotter, let the notes overload
Voice on fire — feel the whole room explode!

[Scat Break – Full group, explosive call & response]
Doo-ba-dee-da! Ba-da-ba-doo! 
(Lead) Burn it up! 
(Group) Burn it up! 
Doo-ba-dee-da ba-da-ba-doo-ba-da! 
Scat it loud, let the fire come through!

[Verse 2]
They said you need the band to make the music mean
But the meanest sound I ever heard was just one voice clean
No backup plan, no safety in the chord
Just the throat and the truth and the will to burn forward

Every note a spark, every phrase a flame
The wickedest swing when there’s no one to blame
Just the voice standing naked in the middle of the room
Setting the whole damn night on fire too soon

[Bridge]
This is the moment the music gets free
When the only thing left is the fire in me

[Final Chorus – Layered, peak heat, group full force]
Voice on fire, wicked and bright
Burning through the silence in the dead of the night
No instruments holding, no safety to tame
This is the pure heat that carries the name

Swing it hotter — don’t you dare pull it back
Voice on fire… and it ain’t never going black

[Outro Scat – Group fading but still hot]
Ba-da-ba-dee ba-doo ba-da… 
Voice on fire… 
(soft group echoes) Burn… burn… burn…
